raidSayLines.line: A woman, maybe 60s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Something moves out there — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline.
It followed you. The dog-shaped silence at the treeline is here.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ Victor killed the dog-shaped silence at the treeline with their party — 3 rounds, 79 taken. Word travels fast. Took Hardlight knife off the body. The village cheers.

A woman, maybe 20s leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 40s, with tattooed arms has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Priya breath
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
Jorge came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Nobody met Nightlight — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.
Nobody met The Static Kite — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
One down — but 1 still holds the treeline. The gorge goes on.

🌙 Night. The lingering Nightlight gorges at the treeline — 1,200 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)

🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Aisha of Ashford with 3 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Aisha of Ashford raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Peter Kim. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Aisha of Ashford didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 1,000 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
